map.逆行射精（尿液精子）检测 使用指南: Retrograde Ejaculation (Sperm in Urine) Test User Guide
map.分别输入射精精液与射精后尿液的体积、精子浓度与总量，并结合尿液 pH、果糖检测，: Enter the volume, sperm concentration and total sperm count for both ejaculate and post-ejaculation urine, together with urine pH and fructose testing; the tool compares the two samples to judge whether sperm reflux into the bladder is present, assisting andrology diagnosis of retrograde ejaculation.
map.精液总精子 ejTotal = ejVol × ejConc: Total sperm in semen ejTotal = ejVol × ejConc
map.射精后尿液中精子的比例。: The proportion of sperm in post-ejaculation urine.
map.：ejTotal=20、urTotal=60、合计 80×10⁶；尿液占比=60: : ejTotal=20, urTotal=60, combined 80×10⁶; the urine share is 60/80×100%=75% ≥50% and >5 million → significant retrograde ejaculation.
map.：urConc=0 → 尿液占比 0%，不支持逆行射精，需查其他原因。: : urConc=0 → the urine share is 0%, which does not support retrograde ejaculation; look for other causes.
map.附睾穿刺精子获取率评估器: Epididymal puncture sperm retrieval rate assessor
map.ICSI 单精子注射成功率评估器: ICSI Intracytoplasmic Sperm Injection Success Rate Assessor
map.尿液中精子占比≥50% 且总量>5×10⁶ 判为显著逆行，常伴射精量少。: Sperm in urine ≥50% with a total >5×10⁶ is judged significant retrograde ejaculation, often with low ejaculate volume.
map.可碱化尿液后回收尿精子行 IUI/ICSI，或药物（拟交感）改善。: Alkalinize the urine to recover sperm for IUI/ICSI, or use drugs (sympathomimetics).
